headline: Argentina Beef Exports Near $4 Billion in Record Nine-Month Surge
summary: Argentine beef exports rose 37% between January and September, surpassing the entire total exported in 2025 and nearing $4 billion, with China as the leading buyer.
why: Agricultural exports are a critical source of foreign currency reserves for Argentina's central bank.

impacts.name: Argentine Beef Exporters
impacts.why: Nine-month export volumes increased 37%, approaching $4 billion.
